description: Rotate an agent's Ed25519 key. Planned mode: configurable overlap (default 24h). Emergency mode: immediate old-key retirement. Returns updated DID document, rotation state, and revocation results.

agent_name.description: Agent name for the passport (default: current session)

delegation_ids_to_revoke.description: Delegation IDs to cascade-revoke during rotation

old_private_key.description: Hex-encoded private key being rotated FROM

name: rotate_key
